verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own natural-language tooling. There is an AI assistant for API questions, a claim that you can 'connect to our APIs using natural language', and an official MCP server for Cursor. But the documented MCP tools only find endpoints from a Spanish or English query and generate request code samples. They do not execute operations such as issuing cards or managing transactions from natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language execution of actual product operations (card, user, transaction actions), documentation of any action-taking MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
